triggering_diagnosis.finding: The explicit K bridge learned R/K ordering and zero/off-path behavior, but on-path free generation produced the unsupported lexical fusion prepare_right instead of prepare_to_yield, with only a 0.0135 NLL preference margin.

objective: Test whether an explicit predicted planning-semantics bottleneck makes the VLM's task-risk interpretation stable and inspectable without moving task relevance into Stage1 UQ or adding direct control.

task_risk_language_bridge.pass_1: ORION visual tokens plus route text and 600 U-independent spatial relevance queries predict R.
task_risk_language_bridge.pass_2: ORION visual tokens plus 600 Stage1-UQ tokens plus seven compact K tokens plus one predicted semantic token generate QA text.
task_risk_language_bridge.zero_uq_contract: K tokens and the predicted semantic token are independent of R when U is identically zero.

structured_semantic_bottleneck.input: global compact K bridge token only

sampling.method: oversample each target stance to the majority count; every non-driving record remains once per epoch

evaluation_gates: language NLL, dense R BCE, and structured stance CE all improve
all five driving-implication variants have the correct structured stance argmax
the minimum target stance probability across the five variants is at least 0.55
on-path K exceeds matched off-path K by at least 0.2
zero-UQ and off-path target answers outrank the matched conservative answer
on-path target answer outranks the matched maintain answer
free generation exactly matches the target stance for all five variants
stop_policy: No GPU launch until the new entry point, source hashes, and fail-closed wrapper pass preflight. Exactly one fresh 240-step submission may be activated by a separate amendment. Failure pauses further Route196 iterations; success unlocks only migration review for the held-out 8-event pilot.
claim_boundary: One-event structured semantic architecture learnability test only; no held-out generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
